frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The presentation or existence of a GROUND that would clear or release a party from blame or obligation (forensic exculpation / warrant of exemption). The derivational family distributes predictably from one nucleus: Form VIII اعتذر = the reflexive act of putting a self-clearing plea before an evaluating authority; مَعْذِرَة/مَعَاذِير = the act/instance and plural pleas; N(II) مُعَذِّرون = agents presenting excuses to obtain exemption; عُذْر = the exempting ground/warrant itself. The root carries no entailment of the plea's truth, its acceptance, or of pardon, and is categorically distinct from the near-homograph عذاب (root ع ذ ب).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The presentation or existence of a GROUND that would clear or release a party from blame or obligation (forensic exculpation / warrant of exemption). The derivational family distributes predictably from one nucleus: Form VIII اعتذر = the reflexive act of putting a self-clearing plea before an evaluating authority; مَعْذِرَة/مَعَاذِير = the act/instance and plural pleas; N(II) مُعَذِّرون = agents presenting excuses to obtain exemption; عُذْر = the exempting ground/warrant itself. The root carries no entailment of the plea's truth, its acceptance, or of pardon, and is categorically distinct from the near-homograph عذاب (root ع ذ ب).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every occurrence of ع ذ ر turns on offering, or possessing, a reason that would release someone from blame or an obligation. In the Form VIII verb it is the act of making excuses for oneself (uniformly forbidden, denied, or futile in-frame); in مَعْذِرَة/مَعَاذِير it is the plea/ground itself; in مُعَذِّرون it is the people making excuses to be exempted; in عُذْر it is the exempting ground or warrant. The Quran does not build the word to mean the excuse is true, accepted, or forgiven — that is always supplied by context, and belated self-clearing before God is consistently shown as unavailing.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT entail: (1) truth/validity of the ground — it may be genuine (18:76, 7:164) or false/rejected (9:66 «قد كفرتم», 9:94 «لن نؤمن لكم»); (2) acceptance/success — most pleas fail, are prohibited, or unheard (30:57, 40:52, 66:7, 77:36); (3) pardon/forgiveness — عذر is only the ground offered, distinct from عفو/غفر (the granting); (4) warning — عُذْرًا is explicitly contrasted with نُذْرًا (77:6); (5) reparative amends/appeasement — معذرة is coordinated against يُسْتَعْتَبُون (root عتب) at 30:57. Distractor control: ع ذ ر is NOT ع ذ ر... i.e. NOT the punishment root ع ذ ب — the homograph-adjacent forms مُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا (7:164), نُعَذِّب (9:66), عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ (9:90) belong to ع ذ ب and must not be read as linking عذر to punishment.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 18:76:13:1 «قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًا»: عذر here is an objectively-attained ground/warrant conceded by the offending party that entitles the OTHER party (Khidr) to part, not a self-exculpatory plea offered by a blameworthy party to a judge — inverting both the polarity (valid/effective, not a rejected plea) and the agent-direction of the dominant self-exculpation frame. It cannot be reduced to the Form-VIII plea sense and forces the root-level unifier up to the broader 'ground for release/exemption.'
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A two-pole lexical split rather than one nucleus: Pole A (subjective, retrospective, usually unavailing self-exculpating plea = all VIII + معذرة + معاذير + معذّرون, ~10 occ.) versus Pole B (objective, valid, delivered/attained ground = عُذْر at 18:76 and 77:6). Rejected as a full split because the valid/invalid contrast crosses form boundaries and is therefore contextual, not morphological: the SAME nominal مَعْذِرَة is a valid pre-judgment discharge at 7:164 («مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ») yet futile at 30:57/40:52 («لا ينفع… معذرتهم»). If validity were lexicalized onto عذر vs معذرة we would not see معذرة carrying the valid sense. The split the competitor detects is an outcome/evaluation difference laid over one shared semantic object — hence a single nucleus with a mild resistant عُذْر sub-class, not two lexicalized roots.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: a single bridged field ('a ground that clears/releases from blame or obligation') coheres across all 12 occurrences with clean morphological division of labor and distinctive Quran-internal negative boundaries (عذر≠نذر at 77:6; معذرة vs استعتاب/عتب at 30:57; efficacy-decoupling at 30:57/40:52; ʾidhn-coupling at 9:90/77:36). This argues against fragmentation and supports a PREFERRED single-nucleus derivational-family account. Three factors bar STRONG/GENERAL and cap at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE per contract: (a) a coherent resistant nominal sub-class — bare-noun عُذْر at 18:76 and 77:6 — whose polarity and agent-direction invert the plea sense and which the Quran nowhere internally bridges to the plea sense; (b) one genuinely underdetermined occurrence (77:6, elliptical/adverbial, semi-frozen in the عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا doublet); (c) the unifier that fits all 12 is broad enough that its discipline rests on the negative boundaries rather than a single positive gloss, and distinctiveness from neighbours rests on thin evidence (one minimal pair, one coordination). A resistant nominal sub-class plus material abstraction caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form VIII اعتذر = the reflexive act of putting forward a self-clearing plea directed at an evaluating authority (إليكم 9:94) or before God/Judgment. In every instance the plea is forbidden, denied, or futile; the root names the act, not its outcome.
clusters.classification_rationale: Five morphologically uniform V(VIII) verbs, all iftaʿala self-directed pleading. Directionality toward a judge (إلى) and rejection supplied by context (لن نؤمن لكم, قد كفرتم, لا يؤذن لهم), never by the lexeme.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 66:7 «لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ»; 77:36 «وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ»; 9:66 «لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ قَدْ كَفَرْتُم»; 9:94 «يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ» and «قُل لَّا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ».

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: مَعْذِرَة (maṣdar-mīmī) / مَعَاذِير (plural) = the act/instance and content of exculpation — the plea or clearing-ground itself. Spans a valid pre-judgment discharge (7:164) and futile pleas (30:57, 40:52, 75:15), showing validity is NOT lexicalized onto the form.
clusters.classification_rationale: Four N nominals of the معذرة/معاذير pattern (qac_pos N, qac_verb_form null), naming the object/content of exculpation; bridged to the VIII act by shared 'plea/ground' semantics. Partitioned by explicit word_refs from the bare-noun عُذْر cluster, which shares N morphology but behaves as a resistant sub-class.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 7:164 «قَالُوا۟ مَعْذِرَةً إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ»: معذرة is a VALID prospective discharge of duty directed إلى ربكم, showing validity is not lexicalized and bridging the valid/invalid seam within one shared semantic object. Contrast 30:57 «لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ» and 40:52 (same frame) and 75:15 «وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ» where the plea is futile.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: عُذْر (bare noun) = the exempting ground/warrant itself, tending toward an objective/attained or externally-delivered ground rather than a self-serving plea. This is a mild but coherent resistant nominal sub-class that inverts the polarity and agent-direction of the dominant self-exculpation sense.
clusters.classification_rationale: Both bare-noun عُذْر tokens (qac_pos N, qac_verb_form null; surface Eu*orFA) resist the self-exculpation nucleus: 18:76 is an objectively-attained warrant conceded to the other party; 77:6 is elliptical/adverbial and underdetermined. The Quran nowhere internally fuses this delivered/attained-ground sense with the offered-plea sense, so they are bridgeable only by broadening to an abstraction the corpus never demonstrates across the seam.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 77:6 «عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا»: عذر is coordinated as a purpose/effect of the divinely cast reminder, contrasted with نذر (warning); it is elliptical/adverbial, semi-frozen in the rhyming doublet, and underdetermined between exoneration/vindication and removal-of-excuse — it cannot be pinned to the blameworthy-party-pleading-to-a-judge frame.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: N(II) مُعَذِّرون = the agents who present excuses in order to obtain exemption (ليؤذن لهم). Bridged to the plea nucleus as the agent-noun of the excuse-making act.
clusters.classification_rationale: Lone Form-II nominal (qac_verb_form II, qac_pos N). ʾidhn-coupling (لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ) situates it squarely in the excuse-to-be-exempted frame; single morphological data point but semantically bridged.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 9:90 «وَجَآءَ ٱلْمُعَذِّرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ لِيُؤْذَنَ لَهُمْ» — agents presenting grounds to be granted leave/exemption.

reconciliation.rationale: Reconciled as a bridge datum, not resistance: it is the SAME معذرة nominal carrying validity because context (إلى ربكم, pre-judgment, لعلهم يتقون) supplies it, confirming that validity is contextual not lexical. It strengthens the single-nucleus account rather than fragmenting it.

Retained as resistant: brevity and the frozen عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا doublet leave direction/beneficiary Quran-internally underdetermined, and its delivered/effected-ground polarity is not bridged to the plea sense; per anti-over-grading it must be flagged, not smoothed.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Elliptical/adverbial عُذْرًا contrasted with نُذْرًا; underdetermined beneficiary/direction and semi-frozen in the doublet; delivered/effected ground rather than a rejected plea.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: عُذْر (bare noun) = the exempting ground/warrant itself, tending toward an objective/attained or externally-delivered ground rather than a self-serving plea. This is a mild but coherent resistant nominal sub-class that inverts the polarity and agent-direction of the dominant self-exculpation sense.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: 77:6 «عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا»: عذر is coordinated as a purpose/effect of the divinely cast reminder, contrasted with نذر (warning); it is elliptical/adverbial, semi-frozen in the rhyming doublet, and underdetermined between exoneration/vindication and removal-of-excuse — it cannot be pinned to the blameworthy-party-pleading-to-a-judge frame.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: Both bare-noun عُذْر tokens (qac_pos N, qac_verb_form null; surface Eu*orFA) resist the self-exculpation nucleus: 18:76 is an objectively-attained warrant conceded to the other party; 77:6 is elliptical/adverbial and underdetermined. The Quran nowhere internally fuses this delivered/attained-ground sense with the offered-plea sense, so they are bridgeable only by broadening to an abstraction the corpus never demonstrates across the seam.
occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: Retained as resistant: brevity and the frozen عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا doublet leave direction/beneficiary Quran-internally underdetermined, and its delivered/effected-ground polarity is not bridged to the plea sense; per anti-over-grading it must be flagged, not smoothed.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) converged on MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and independently identified 18:76 (and 77:6) as the resistant nominal seam and 7:164 as the valid-discharge bridge datum.
candidate_root_contribution: The presentation or existence of a GROUND that would clear or release a party from blame or obligation (forensic exculpation / warrant of exemption). The derivational family distributes predictably from one nucleus: Form VIII اعتذر = the reflexive act of putting a self-clearing plea before an evaluating authority; مَعْذِرَة/مَعَاذِير = the act/instance and plural pleas; N(II) مُعَذِّرون = agents presenting excuses to obtain exemption; عُذْر = the exempting ground/warrant itself. The root carries no entailment of the plea's truth, its acceptance, or of pardon, and is categorically distinct from the near-homograph عذاب (root ع ذ ب).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 12/12 occurrences read from the packet: 5 V(VIII) verbs, 4 معذرة/معاذير nominals, 1 N(II) participle, 2 bare-noun عُذْر, with verse_text and word_refs confirmed against the packet.
layer_attribution.derivation: Forms distribute from one nucleus: VIII iftaʿala = reflexive self-clearing act; maṣdar-mīmī مَعْذِرَة/plural مَعَاذِير = act/instance and content; N(II) مُعَذِّرون = agent noun; عُذْر = the bare ground/warrant. Morphological division of labor is regular but does not by itself fix meaning.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Root-level (derivational-family) claim: 'ground/plea for release from blame or obligation.' A mild lexicalized drift is noted in the bare-noun عُذْر toward objective/delivered warrant, treated as a resistant sub-class rather than a separate root.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Outcome and validity (لا ينفع, لن نؤمن, قد كفرتم, لعلهم يتقون), directionality (إلى ربكم, إليكم), and the exculpation-vs-warning contrast (عذر/نذر) are contextual/narrative — they frame the pleas as unavailing before God but are NOT promoted into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 7:164 reconciled as a valid-discharge bridge (validity is contextual, keeping one nucleus); 77:6 retained as resistant despite surface bridgeability due to underdetermination; both prevent over-grading to STRONG.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The bare-noun عُذْر seam (18:76, 77:6) remains unbridged to the plea family within the corpus; its polarity/agent-direction inversion and 77:6's underdetermination are the standing residue capping the result at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which عذر/معذرة/اعتذر denotes something OTHER than a ground/plea for release from blame or obligation — e.g. a token that genuinely means pardon-as-granted (عفو/غفر), or contrition/repentance (توبة), or is shown to require the excuse's truth or its acceptance as part of the lexeme rather than from context.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 5 V(VIII) tokens (66:7, 77:36, 9:66, 9:94×2), the معذرة/معاذير nominals (30:57, 40:52, 75:15, 7:164), the participle 9:90, and especially the bare-noun عُذْر tokens (18:76, 77:6).
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test each occurrence's context for whether the release/clearing outcome or the truth of the ground is encoded by the lexeme itself versus supplied by surrounding words (ينفع/لا ينفع, نعفو/نعذب, لن نؤمن, يؤذن); check whether عذر ever substitutes for or entails عفو/غفر/توبة.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude the near-homograph root ع ذ ب (مُعَذِّبُهُمْ/عَذَابًا 7:164, نُعَذِّب 9:66, عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ 9:90) which co-occurs but is a false friend; keep عتب/استعتاب (30:57) and نذر (77:6) as contrast controls, not as this root.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a finding holds, the single-nucleus 'ground for release from blame/obligation' account is falsified and the root must be re-analyzed as multi-class or lexicalized (e.g. splitting delivered-ground عُذْر from the plea family), moving research_state toward UNRESOLVED or a narrower LEXICALIZED_CLASS claim.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal reading bridges عُذْر at 18:76/77:6 (attained/delivered ground) to the self-exculpatory plea family without abstraction, re-evaluate for possible STRONG/GENERAL unity.
If 77:6 «عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا» is disambiguated by further internal evidence (beneficiary/direction fixed), reassess whether the عُذْر sub-class remains resistant or collapses into the nucleus.

If the lone N(II) participle مُعَذِّرون (9:90) or any معذرة token is shown to lexicalize an outcome (validity/acceptance) rather than take it from context, reopen the negative boundary that outcome is not encoded.
If additional analysis reclassifies any co-occurring ع ذ ب form (7:164, 9:66, 9:90) as genuinely belonging to ع ذ ر, reopen the punishment-boundary exclusion.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with failing_occurrences=[] cannot be claimed because the bare-noun عُذْر sub-class (18:76, 77:6) resists the self-exculpation nucleus and is not Quran-internally bridged to it. The core plea/ground account is distinctive and adversarially clean across 10/12 (ʾidhn-coupling, efficacy-decoupling, عذر≠نذر, معذرة vs استعتاب), so the result is PREFERRED but capped at MODERATE; per contract this is NOT_RUN with the resistant occurrences recorded rather than PASSED.
